entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. It's a pair of cycling shoes I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Road Cycling Shoes delivered on December 30th. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I guess it's preference? I've tried them on a few rides, and they're just... they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I thought maybe adjusting the cleats would change how my foot sat, but it didn't help at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.
I know. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for these. I'm just so disappointed. I really needed that money back for my upcoming race fees. I was hoping I could get a refund.

Of course. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see here you received the item 19 days ago. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Isaac. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I really appreciate your help. You've made my day.
I'm glad I could help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
